title: An aircraft belonging to Buddha Air overshoots the runway while landing at Bhadrapur Airport from Kathmandu, injuring seven people.
text: Buddha Air Pvt. Ltd is an airline based in Lalitpur, Nepal.

title: 2 February – 2026 Women's T20 World Cup Qualifier
text: The 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup Global Qualifier was the seventh edition of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup Global Qualifier, hosted by Cricket Association of Nepal from 18 January 1 February 2026. It served as the final stage of the qualification process for the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup.
wiki: 2026 Women's T20 World Cup Global Qualifier

title: A bus falls into the Trishuli River in Dhading District, killing 19 people and injuring 25 others.
text: The Trishuli River is one of the major tributaries of the Narayani River basin in central Nepal. The river is formed by the merger of the Gyirong Tsangpo (Kerung Khola) and the Lende Khola (Donglin Tsangpo) originating in Gyirong County of Tibet, which join together near the Rasuwa Gadhi on the Nepal–Tibet border.

title: A vehicle carrying an election team plunges in Ramechhap, killing two people.
text: Ramechhap Municipality is a municipality in Ramechhap District in Bagmati Province of Nepal. It was established on 2 December 2014 by merging the former village development committees Old-Ramechhap, Okhreni and Sukajor.

title: 2026 Nepalese general election: The Rastriya Swatantra Party wins a majority in the House of Representatives.
text: The House of Representatives is the lower house of the bicameral Federal Parliament of Nepal, with the upper house being the National Assembly. Members of the House of Representatives are elected through a parallel voting system.

title: Following his Rastriya Swatantra Party's landslide victory in the general election, Balendra Shah is sworn as Prime Minister of Nepal, succeeding interim prime minister Sushila Karki.
text: Sushila Karki is a Nepalese lawyer and stateswoman who served as chief justice of Nepal from 2016 to 2017 and as interim prime minister of Nepal from 2025 to 2026. She became prime minister following the youth protests of September 2025 that led to her predecessor's resignation.

title: Former prime minister K. P. Sharma Oli is arrested over his alleged involvement in the crackdown on the 2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests.
text: Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli better known as K.P. Sharma Oli, is a Nepali politician who served three terms as the prime minister of Nepal, from 2015 to 2016, 2018 to 2021, and 2024 to 2025. He has served as the chairman of the Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist) since 2014.

title: A Turkish Airlines passenger aircraft catches fire while landing at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu. All passengers and crew are evacuated.
text: Turkish Airlines, or legally Türk Hava Yolları Anonim Ortaklığı, is the flag carrier of Turkey. As of September 2026, it operates scheduled services to 358 destinations (including cargo) in global.

title: At least 1,451 people are killed following a flash flood along the border with Tibet.
text: On the morning of 26 August 2026, a series of flash floods and debris flows destroyed the Gyirong Port on the China–Nepal border and struck dozens of settlements along a 72 km stretch of the Trishuli River in Nepal. These events are also known as the 2026 Nepal-China floods, Bhotekoshi flood, or Rasuwa flood.

title: Gauri Kumar Yadav resigns as industry minister amid criticism over her remarks on the liquified petroleum gas bottling sector.
text: Liquefied petroleum gas, also referred to as liquid petroleum gas, is a fuel gas which contains a flammable mixture of hydrocarbon gases, specifically propane, butane and isobutane. It can also contain some propylene, butylene, and isobutylene.

title: An avalanche hits a base camp near Himlung Himal peak, killing at least four people.
text: Nemjung or Nimjung is a mountain in the Himalayas of Nepal. It is located approximately 150 kilometres northwest of the Nepalese capital Kathmandu and about 25 km (16 mi) northwest of the eight-thousander, Manaslu.

title: Former chief justice Cholendra Shumsher JB Rana is briefly taken into police custody under unspecified circumstances.
text: Cholendra Shumsher Jung Bahadur Rana is a former chief justice of Nepal. He is the 29th Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Nepal appointed and oathed by the President Bidya Devi Bhandari on the recommendation of Constitutional Council of Nepal on 2 January 2019.

title: 2026 Nepal Premier League, the third edition of the Nepal Premier League begins in Kirtipur, Nepal.
text: The 2026 Nepal Premier League, also known as Siddhartha Bank NPL 2026 for sponsorship reasons, is the third edition of the Nepal Premier League, a professional Twenty20 cricket franchise league in Nepal. The tournament features eight teams competing in 32 matches from 26 October to 21 November 2026.

title: 2026 Nepalese general election: The Rastriya Swatantra Party led by Balen Shah wins a landslide victory.
text: Early general elections were held in Nepal on 5 March 2026 to elect the 275 members of the House of Representatives as announced on 12 September 2025 by the President of Nepal, on the recommendation of the government of Nepal. The election was called after youth protests in September 2025 led to the resignation of Prime Minister K. P. Sharma Oli.

title: September 25–27 – Flash flooding and landslides kill at least 56 people in India and at least 14 people in Nepal. For Nepal this occurs one month on from devastating floods.
text: A flash flood is a rapid flooding of low-lying areas: washes, rivers, dry lakes, and depressions. It may be caused by heavy rain associated with a severe thunderstorm, hurricane, or tropical storm, or by meltwater from ice and snow.

title: Elephants in the Fog
text: Elephants in the Fog is a 2026 thriller film written and directed by Abinash Bikram Shah, in his directorial debut. Starring Pushpa Thing Lama, Deepika Yadav, Jasmine Bishwokarma, Aliz Ghimire, and Dura Sanjay Kumar Gupta, it follows a Nepalese Kinnar community struggle to protect itself.
